description: Agent Customs Records: submit customs bond records with the entry activity they answer to: each bond with its id, bond number, whether it is continuous or single-transaction, the amount, the currency, the principal, the surety, the moments it takes effect and its term ends, the share of the duties recorded under a continuous bond its amount must cover and the entry a single-transaction bond names; each renewal with its id, the bond, the moment renewed and the moment the renewed term ends; each entry with its id, entry number, the bond it was filed under, the moment filed, the duties, taxes and fees recorded and the principal and surety the entry records. The signed report gives the bonds and the entries, each continuous bond’s amount against the stated share of the duties recorded under it, each single-transaction bond against the entries recorded under it, each bond term carried forward by its renewals against the entries filed under its number, and each entry’s principal and surety against its bond, and counts them, and names divergent customs bond records: a continuous bond whose amount the recorded entry volume has outgrown, a single-transaction bond recorded against an entry it does not name, a bond lapsed while entries continued under the bond number with no renewal recorded, and a bond principal or surety recorded differently in the bond and the entry records; then an entry naming a bond the records do not hold and a single-transaction bond naming an entry the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No bonds, a continuous bond with no amount or sufficiency share, or a bond with no term end leaves those points unverified. Bonds, renewals and entries match by letters and digits, amounts compare to the cent, terms by the day, and principals and sureties without case, punctuation or company endings. This reads whether each customs bond covers the entries filed under it. Verdict customs_bond_divergent, customs_bond_partial, customs_bond_unverified or customs_bond_consistent. POST /api/customs-bond-check. Reads the customs and trade records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no entry, pays no duty, contacts no customs authority or broker and gives no customs or legal advice, which stay with the importer, its licensed customs broker and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Customs Records reads an importer’s or exporter’s own customs and trade records: entry summaries, tariff classification records, duty and fee payment records, broker filing records, country-of-origin and marking records, declared-value records, customs bond records and drawback claim records, each against the commercial invoices and duty payment records, the rulings on file, the entries, the importer’s own copies, the origin support on file, the invoices and payments, the entry activity or the duty recorded as paid and the proof on file. The family’s ground is the paper behind the border crossing: what was declared, how it was classified, what duty was paid, and whether the bond and the drawback claims line up; the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, and the Agent Logistics family reads where a shipment is and when it moves, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-customs-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-customs-records/.
